candidate_relations.reason: The intercellular epidermal IgG/C3 deposition with acantholytic keratinocytes supports pemphigus erythematosus; cutaneous lupus alone does not capture the pemphigus component.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Related autoimmune photodistributed dermatosis and differential, but not pemphigus erythematosus (Senear-Usher syndrome).
